searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he repository glossary the awtsmoos gives language to vessels so maintainers can share one map; awtsmoos.com has its own names, and this glossary prevents a semantic trap. awtsmoos the project name and recurring conceptual vocabulary throughout source comments, apis, apps, and runtime systems. this documentation uses the spelling present in the repository and user instructions. geelooy the default public filesystem root is geelooy/ because awtsmoosstaticserver.maindir defaults to config.public "geelooy". it contains pages, applications, games, shared browser code, and the filesystem located api tree. derech a dynamic route module convention represented by awtsmoos.derech.js. the dynamic server searches upward through the physical request path for such files, then evaluates their route definitions. the current api tree contains 21 derech mount files. $i a common server side request/context vessel passed to derech code. it can expose db access, request/user state, helper methods, url information, body/query vessels, route parameters, and response utilities depending on the runtime. it is not a url dollar path segment. $ get, $ post, $ delete php like names used by route code for parsed input vessels. they are data objects, not path grammar. dynamic parameter a url route segment declared as :name. example: /:sefer/section/:section. a terminal :name is a catch all. see routes/dynamic paths.md. heichel / heichelos a core social/content domain represented across browser surfaces and social api modules. the source includes heichel creation/editing, posts, series, editors, review/governance, comments, and discovery. treat it as a first class content container/domain, not merely a page name. alias a user/social identity concept heavily used by social routes. many write operations are authorized in terms of whether the current identity owns or may act for an alias. dosdb the persistence engine instantiated by the dynamic server. the database root is configurable by environment/local config/tracked config and exposed as process.awtsmoosdbpath. perutah / perutas value/economy vocabulary used in wallet and tunnel control commerce/treasury systems. read the route implementation before assuming units, accounting guarantees, or production payment semantics. tunnel the remote device/agent bridge spanning apps, apis, shared client code, installer artifacts, live calls, previews, mission rooms, filesystem actions, and provider/compute/economy systems. mission room a collaboration/agent orchestration concept with both http control routes and websocket server behavior. generated docs markdown under docs/generated/, fully regenerated by node scripts/docs/generate docs.js. never hand maintain them as authoritative narrative; change the generator or source instead.
